title: librarian_agent/kb/wiki/map.json -- the store's relations, as nodes and typed edges, for the console to draw
description: Rendered from the store by librarian_agent/src/wiki.py beside the wiki pages (librarian task 060) and never edited by hand. Added 2026-10-27: the map was shaped in task 060 and judged by check 87 for its version, footer and value keys, but no line in ARTIFACT_SCHEMA named it, so the first real render failed check 1 as an unknown artifact. Check 87's history fixtures could not see that, because each row reads only the check it names. A node is a wiki page or an entry; an entry node carries its grade, source and status as the entry records them, so nothing the console draws is shown without its provenance. No node or edge carries a number taken from an entry -- values stay on the pages -- and check 87 refuses a `value` or `values` key anywhere. Edge types are an open word, because the store's relation fields grow; the shape of an edge does not.

footer.pattern: ^Generated from the knowledge store at kbv-[0-9a-f]{12}\. Do not edit by hand: correct the store and regenerate\.$
footer.description: the wiki pages' one footer line. Check 87 requires it to name kb_version

dangling.description: a relation an entry states toward an id the store does not hold. Listed, never drawn as an edge

grade.description: as the entry records it. E6 never enters the store, so it never reaches the map

status.description: the server's status. Being in conflict is not a status: it is a conflict_with edge, and it counts in the page's disputed

kind.description: the page's subject kind: device, quantity, observable, sample, configuration

coverage.description: how many current entries about the subject stand at each grade, zeros written

disputed.description: how many entries about the subject stand in a conflict

type.description: about, supports, input_of, conflict_with, refutes, supersedes, and whatever relation field the store adds next

stated_by.description: the entry whose field states the relation
